barriers.accepted_or_duplicate: durable inbox decision then append-only source-quality receipt before handler success and source offset commit
barriers.invalid_rejected_or_conflict: permanent error only; canonical dlq.v1 broker ACK then append-only source-quality receipt then source offset commit
barriers.transient_failure: database network and broker failures remain uncommitted and replayable
barriers.missing: emitted by source-offset reconciliation rather than record classification

classification.accepted: new inbox row or replay of the same Kafka source tuple
classification.duplicate: same event and payload observed at another Kafka source tuple
classification.rejected: wrong topic duplicate headers or header/key/body mismatch
classification.invalid: invalid JSON or invalid AssetUpsertedV2 value
classification.late: previously unseen aggregate_version below the durable inbox maximum
classification.conflict: authoritative history or inbox identity collision

rollout.rollback: roll back the workload image while retaining append-only inbox, DLQ and audit receipt rows

proves: consumer code enforces DLQ ACK before permanent-failure offset commit
success and DLQ paths persist deterministic source-quality receipts
does_not_prove: the changed asset-service image is deployed
a real poison message and offset were reconciled in Kubernetes
OpenSearch, NebulaGraph, or ClickHouse projections are current
